notes:
REF-BM-02: Simulated title/description enrichment exists, but it does not fetch the target page, favicon, or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark; no duplicate convergence exists.
REF-BM-07: The list exposes title, description, and tags, but only generated letter badges rather than collected favicons.
REF-BM-10: Tag input has no autocomplete or existing-tag suggestions.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable filters.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: No #tag syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal quote characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the entire filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or archive action is implemented.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archiving is absent; only deletion works.
REF-BM-28: The Archive navigation is a hard-coded empty stub.
REF-BM-29: No reusable saved-filter bundles exist.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: The Settings button has no behavior or personal display settings.
